rows.name: 90/90 Hip Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit with both knees bent around 90 degrees in opposite directions.

Execution: Rotate knees side to side or lean into positions while staying controlled.

Cues: Move slowly; Stay tall; Don't force range

rows.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
rows.instructions:
Setup: Kneel or stand with wheel under shoulders and brace strongly.

Execution: Roll forward while resisting back extension, then pull back to start.

Cues: Ribs down; Glutes tight; Only go as far as control allows

coaching_cues: Only go as far as control allows

rows.name: Active Hang
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang from bar and gently depress shoulder blades.

Execution: Hold shoulders slightly away from ears without bending elbows.

Cues: Straight elbows; Shoulders down; Breathe

rows.name: Adductor Rockback
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start on hands/knees and extend one leg to side with foot planted.

Execution: Rock hips backward while keeping spine controlled, then return.

Cues: Hips back; Long spine; Gentle range

rows.name: Arnold Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start with dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you.

Execution: Rotate palms outward as you press overhead, reversing on the way down.

Cues: Smooth rotation; Ribs down; Control range

rows.name: Assisted Dip
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set assistance and support body securely.

Execution: Lower to comfortable depth and press back up.

Cues: Shoulders down; Control depth; No bounce

rows.name: Assisted Pull-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set assistance and position knees/feet securely.

Execution: Pull body upward by driving elbows down, then lower fully.

Cues: No swinging; Full range; Controlled

rows.name: B-Stance Hip Thrust
rows.instructions:
Setup: Use staggered feet with most pressure through one foot.

Execution: Drive hips up emphasizing front/working leg.

Cues: Pelvis level; Ribs down; Squeeze

rows.name: B-Stance Romanian Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stagger feet with most weight on front leg and rear toes as kickstand.

Execution: Hinge through front hip and return to standing.

Cues: Front leg works; Hips square; Hinge back

rows.name: Back Extension
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set hips securely on pad with spine neutral.

Execution: Hinge down at hips and extend until body is aligned, not hyperextended.

Cues: Move at hips; Neutral neck; Don't overextend

rows.name: Back Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set bar securely across upper back, brace, and stand with stable foot position.

Execution: Sit down between hips and knees, then drive through feet to stand.

Cues: Brace; Knees track toes; Keep whole foot down

rows.name: Band Pull-Apart
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold band at shoulder height with arms straight but not locked.

Execution: Pull band apart by moving arms outward, then return slowly.

Cues: Shoulders down; Don't arch; Control return

rows.name: Battle Rope Slams
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand athletic holding rope ends.

Execution: Raise ropes and forcefully slam them down, repeating with control.

Cues: Use whole body; Brace; Maintain space

rows.name: Battle Rope Waves
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand athletic holding rope ends with slack removed.

Execution: Create repeated waves using arms while maintaining stable torso.

Cues: Athletic stance; Breathe; Keep waves consistent

rows.name: Bear Crawl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start on hands and toes with knees hovering just off floor.

Execution: Crawl using opposite hand and foot while keeping hips low and stable.

Cues: Small steps; Hips level; Brace

rows.name: Belt Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Secure belt around hips and stand on platform.

Execution: Squat down while torso stays relatively upright, then drive up.

Cues: Whole foot; Sit between hips; Stay balanced

rows.name: Bench Dip
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place hands on stable bench behind you and feet securely positioned.

Execution: Lower only to a comfortable shoulder depth and press back up.

Cues: Keep shoulders comfortable; Controlled depth; No bouncing

rows.name: Bench Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on a bench with feet planted and shoulder blades set back and down.

Execution: Lower the resistance toward mid-chest, then press up while maintaining your upper-back position.

Cues: Feet planted; Wrists stacked; Control the lowering

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Equipment can swap without changing the core movement record.

rows.name: Bent-Over Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hinge at hips with neutral spine and brace torso.

Execution: Pull toward lower ribs, then lower until arms extend.

Cues: Hinge and hold; Elbows back; No jerking

rows.name: Biceps Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand or sit tall with upper arms near sides.

Execution: Flex elbows to bring resistance toward shoulders, then lower fully.

Cues: Elbows stay put; No swinging; Full extension

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Recommended movement-first record: equipment is swappable.

rows.name: Bicycle Crunch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with hands lightly supporting head.

Execution: Rotate shoulder toward opposite knee while extending other leg, then alternate.

Cues: Slow rotation; Don't pull neck; Exhale

rows.name: Bike Sprint
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set bike fit safely and warm up.

Execution: Accelerate to prescribed hard effort while maintaining controlled posture.

Cues: Secure setup; Smooth cadence; Recover fully

rows.name: Bird Dog
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start on hands and knees with spine neutral.

Execution: Reach opposite arm and leg long without rotating torso, then switch.

Cues: Hips square; Reach long; Don't arch

rows.name: Block Pull
rows.instructions:
Setup: Elevate loaded bar on stable blocks and set deadlift position.

Execution: Lift to standing with normal deadlift mechanics and return.

Cues: Brace; Load close; Stable blocks

rows.name: Box Jump
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand facing a stable box at appropriate height.

Execution: Load hips and jump onto box, landing softly with full foot contact.

Cues: Choose safe height; Land soft; Step down

rows.name: Box Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set box behind at safe height and brace under load.

Execution: Sit back to lightly contact box, maintain tension, and stand.

Cues: Don't collapse; Stay braced; Drive through feet

rows.name: Broad Jump
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with feet athletic and arms ready.

Execution: Load hips and jump forward, landing softly on both feet.

Cues: Stick landing; Use arms; Reset between reps

rows.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place rear foot on bench and front foot far enough forward for balance.

Execution: Lower rear knee while controlling front leg, then drive up.

Cues: Stay balanced; Front foot planted; Control depth

rows.name: Cable Chop
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand beside a high or mid cable with feet stable.

Execution: Rotate through torso/hips as appropriate to move handle across body.

Cues: Control rotation; Brace; Don't yank

rows.name: Cable Crunch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Kneel or stand with high cable positioned securely.

Execution: Flex trunk by bringing ribs toward pelvis while hips remain relatively stable.

Cues: Curl torso; Exhale; Don't just hinge hips

rows.name: Cable Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand facing low cable with handle close to body.

Execution: Hinge and extend hips while keeping resistance close.

Cues: Hips back; Brace; Don't squat excessively

rows.name: Cable External Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set cable around elbow height and keep elbow fixed.

Execution: Rotate forearm away from body while upper arm stays still.

Cues: Very light; Elbow fixed; Slow

rows.name: Cable Front Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with low cable and handle in front of body.

Execution: Raise arm forward to shoulder height and lower slowly.

Cues: Ribs down; No swing; Soft elbow

rows.name: Cable Hip Abduction
rows.instructions:
Setup: Attach low cable to ankle and stand side-on with support.

Execution: Move leg outward without tilting pelvis, then return.

Cues: Pelvis still; Small range; Control

rows.name: Cable Hip Adduction
rows.instructions:
Setup: Attach low cable to ankle and stand side-on.

Execution: Draw working leg across/toward midline and return slowly.

Cues: Stay tall; Pelvis still; No swing

rows.name: Cable Hip Flexion
rows.instructions:
Setup: Attach low cable to ankle and stand with support.

Execution: Drive knee forward/up without leaning back, then return slowly.

Cues: Pelvis level; Stay tall; Control

rows.name: Cable Internal Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set cable around elbow height with elbow near side.

Execution: Rotate forearm toward body without torso rotation.

Cues: Light; Elbow fixed; No twisting

rows.name: Cable Lateral Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand beside low cable with handle in outside or inside hand as preferred.

Execution: Raise arm to side to about shoulder height and lower slowly.

Cues: Lead elbow; No lean; Control

rows.name: Cable Leg Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Attach low cable to ankle and stabilize thigh/torso.

Execution: Bend knee to curl heel toward glute and return slowly.

Cues: Thigh still; Full control; No hip swing

rows.name: Cable Leg Extension
rows.instructions:
Setup: Attach low cable appropriately and stabilize thigh.

Execution: Extend knee to straighten leg and return under control.

Cues: Thigh still; Squeeze quad; Light load

rows.name: Cable Lift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set cable low and stand sideways with stable stance.

Execution: Move handle diagonally upward across body with controlled rotation.

Cues: Brace; Smooth diagonal; Control return

rows.name: Cable Reverse Fly
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set cables around shoulder height and cross/hold as appropriate.

Execution: Open arms outward while torso remains stable.

Cues: Soft elbows; No shrugging; Slow return

rows.name: Cable Row to Neck
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set cable around upper-chest height with rope or wide handle.

Execution: Pull toward upper chest/neck with elbows high and controlled.

Cues: Light load; Elbows high; No shrugging

rows.name: Cable Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold low cable handle at chest or in front and stand balanced.

Execution: Squat down while resisting forward pull, then stand.

Cues: Whole foot; Chest controlled; Knees track toes

rows.name: Cable Y Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set low cables and stand tall with arms crossed or independent.

Execution: Raise arms diagonally into a Y while keeping ribs controlled.

Cues: Light load; Reach long; No shrugging

rows.name: Calf Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place balls of feet on leg press platform with knees safely positioned.

Execution: Press through toes to plantarflex and lower heels carefully.

Cues: Small controlled motion; Don't unlock platform unsafely; Full range

rows.name: Calf Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place hands on support and step one foot back with heel down.

Execution: Lean forward until calf stretch is felt while keeping heel planted.

Cues: Heel down; Toes forward; Gentle stretch

rows.name: Cat-Cow
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start on hands and knees.

Execution: Alternate gently between spinal flexion and extension with breathing.

Cues: Move segmentally; Don't force; Breathe

rows.name: Chest Fly
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set arms slightly bent and chest tall.

Execution: Bring arms together in a wide hugging motion, then return under control.

Cues: Soft elbows; Squeeze chest; Avoid overstretching

rows.name: Chest-Supported Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support chest on an incline pad or machine.

Execution: Pull elbows back without lifting chest, then lower fully.

Cues: Chest stays down; No shrugging; Pause at top

rows.name: Child's Pose
rows.instructions:
Setup: Kneel and sit hips toward heels with arms reaching forward.

Execution: Relax into position while breathing slowly.

Cues: Breathe; Reach long; Comfortable knees

rows.name: Chin-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang with palms facing you and body controlled.

Execution: Pull until chin clears bar, then lower to full extension.

Cues: Chest up; No kicking; Full range

rows.name: Clamshell
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on side with hips and knees bent and feet together.

Execution: Open top knee without rolling pelvis backward, then close slowly.

Cues: Pelvis stacked; Feet together; Small range

rows.name: Clean & Jerk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand over the bar with a clean grip and a flat back.

Execution: Clean the bar to the shoulders, then jerk it overhead and stand tall.

Cues: Fast elbows; Solid rack; Finish the jerk

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Competition pairing. Power Clean (249), Push Jerk, and Split Jerk stay available as separate cards.

rows.name: Close-Grip Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on bench with hands somewhat narrower than standard press.

Execution: Lower to chest with elbows controlled and press up.

Cues: Don't go excessively narrow; Wrists stacked; Elbows controlled

rows.name: Close-Grip Pulldown
rows.instructions:
Setup: Use a close or neutral handle and anchor thighs.

Execution: Pull handle toward upper chest while driving elbows down.

Cues: Don't lean excessively; Full stretch; Squeeze lats

rows.name: Concentration Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit and brace upper arm against inner thigh or stable position.

Execution: Curl toward shoulder and lower slowly.

Cues: Upper arm fixed; Squeeze; Full extension

rows.name: Copenhagen Plank
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support upper leg on bench with elbow/forearm under shoulder.

Execution: Lift hips and hold body aligned while lower leg is supported or free.

Cues: Start short lever; Hips high; Shoulder stacked

rows.name: Cossack Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Take a wide stance with toes comfortable.

Execution: Shift into one hip, bending one knee while opposite leg stays long, then switch/return.

Cues: Heel down; Knee tracks toes; Use comfortable depth

rows.name: Crab Walk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit, place hands behind, feet planted, and lift hips.

Execution: Travel using coordinated hands and feet while keeping hips elevated.

Cues: Shoulders comfortable; Hips up; Controlled

rows.name: Crunch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie or sit in a position that allows controlled trunk flexion.

Execution: Bring ribs toward pelvis without pulling on neck, then return.

Cues: Exhale up; Small controlled range; Don't yank neck

rows.name: Curtsy Lunge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall and step one leg diagonally behind the other.

Execution: Lower under control and push through front foot to return.

Cues: Use comfortable crossover; Knee tracks foot; Balance

rows.name: Cyclist Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Use close stance with heels slightly elevated.

Execution: Allow knees to travel forward as you squat, then stand.

Cues: Heels supported; Stay tall; Controlled depth

rows.name: Dead Bug
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with hips and knees at 90 degrees and arms up.

Execution: Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping low back controlled, then switch.

Cues: Ribs down; Move slowly; Low back controlled

rows.name: Dead Hang
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang from secure bar with grip of choice.

Execution: Maintain controlled hang for time with shoulders relaxed or lightly active as intended.

Cues: Secure grip; No swinging; Stop for shoulder pain

rows.name: Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set feet and grip, brace trunk, and position load close to body.

Execution: Push floor away and extend hips and knees together; return load with control.

Cues: Brace; Load close; Don't jerk from floor

rows.name: Decline Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Secure legs on a decline bench and set shoulder blades.

Execution: Lower toward lower chest and press to full control.

Cues: Stay secured; Wrists stacked; Smooth reps

rows.name: Decline Push-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Elevate feet on a stable surface with hands on floor.

Execution: Lower chest under control and press back up.

Cues: Keep hips level; Brace; Controlled elbows

rows.name: Deep Squat Hold
rows.instructions:
Setup: Take comfortable squat stance and descend to a supported deep squat.

Execution: Hold while breathing and gently exploring hip/ankle position.

Cues: Whole foot; Breathe; Use support

rows.name: Dip
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support yourself on parallel bars with shoulders down.

Execution: Lower with control, leaning slightly forward for chest emphasis, then press up.

Cues: Shoulders down; Controlled depth; No bouncing

rows.name: Donkey Calf Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hinge torso forward with balls of feet supported and heels free.

Execution: Rise onto toes and lower through full stretch.

Cues: Full range; Pause top; Don't bounce

rows.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place forearm on doorway with elbow around shoulder height or lower.

Execution: Gently turn body away until chest stretch is felt.

Cues: Gentle; Shoulder down; Don't force

rows.name: Elliptical
rows.instructions:
Setup: Step onto pedals and grip handles as desired.

Execution: Move smoothly through elliptical stride at prescribed effort.

Cues: Stay tall; Smooth rhythm; Don't bounce

rows.name: External Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Keep upper arm positioned securely and elbow bent about 90 degrees.

Execution: Rotate forearm outward without letting upper arm drift.

Cues: Light load; Elbow fixed; Slow control

rows.name: Face Pull
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set rope around face height and stand tall.

Execution: Pull rope toward face while separating hands and rotating shoulders outward.

Cues: Elbows high; Hands apart; Don't shrug

rows.name: Farmer Carry
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall holding heavy loads at both sides.

Execution: Walk with controlled steps while maintaining posture.

Cues: Tall posture; Strong grip; Don't rush

rows.name: Figure-Four Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Cross one ankle over opposite thigh while seated or lying.

Execution: Draw legs toward torso or hinge forward until glute stretch is felt.

Cues: Gentle pressure; Keep ankle comfortable; Breathe

rows.name: Floor Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on floor with knees bent and upper arms able to contact floor.

Execution: Lower until upper arms gently touch floor, then press up.

Cues: Pause softly; Wrists stacked; Shoulders set

rows.name: Frog Pump
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with soles together and knees opened outward.

Execution: Drive hips up by squeezing glutes and lower under control.

Cues: Squeeze hard; Ribs down; Short controlled reps

rows.name: Front Rack Carry
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold load securely in front-rack position.

Execution: Walk while keeping ribs down and torso tall.

Cues: Brace; Elbows controlled; Breathe behind brace

rows.name: Front Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall holding resistance in front of thighs.

Execution: Raise arms forward to about shoulder height and lower under control.

Cues: Ribs down; Soft elbows; No momentum

rows.name: Front Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support load at front of shoulders and keep torso tall.

Execution: Descend between hips and knees while keeping elbows/chest up, then stand.

Cues: Elbows up; Brace; Knees track toes

rows.name: Glute Bridge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted.

Execution: Drive hips upward by squeezing glutes, then lower under control.

Cues: Ribs down; Push through feet; Don't overarch

rows.name: Glute Kickback
rows.instructions:
Setup: Brace torso and attach resistance to one leg if needed.

Execution: Extend leg backward from hip without rotating pelvis.

Cues: Pelvis square; Squeeze glute; Don't arch back

rows.name: Goblet Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold one weight close to chest and set feet comfortably.

Execution: Squat down between legs and stand while keeping torso controlled.

Cues: Weight close; Whole foot down; Knees track toes

rows.name: Good Morning
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place load securely across upper back and brace.

Execution: Push hips back with soft knees until hamstrings load, then stand.

Cues: Light-to-moderate load; Hips back; Neutral spine

rows.name: Grip Squeeze
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold gripper or object comfortably in hand.

Execution: Squeeze firmly, pause, and release under control.

Cues: Full squeeze; Wrist neutral; Don't overdo volume

rows.name: Groin Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit with soles together or use wide stance comfortably.

Execution: Allow knees/hips to open until gentle inner-thigh stretch is felt.

Cues: Don't force; Breathe; Tall posture

rows.name: Hack Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set feet on platform and back/shoulders securely against pads.

Execution: Lower sled through comfortable depth and press platform away.

Cues: Knees track toes; Don't lock hard; Control depth

rows.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Kneel with one knee down and hold landmine at shoulder.

Execution: Press diagonally upward while keeping torso square.

Cues: Squeeze glute; Ribs down; Stay square

rows.name: Hammer Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold handles with neutral palms and upper arms by sides.

Execution: Curl while keeping palms facing each other, then lower fully.

Cues: Neutral grip; Elbows fixed; No swinging

rows.name: Hamstring Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Position one leg extended with spine long.

Execution: Hinge forward from hips until gentle hamstring stretch is felt.

Cues: Long spine; Don't bounce; Gentle

rows.name: Handstand Push-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set stable handstand against wall or free-standing if skilled.

Execution: Lower head under control and press to extended arms.

Cues: Advanced only; Stable setup; Controlled depth

rows.name: Hang Clean
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold the bar at the hang — mid-thigh or just above the knee — with a flat back.

Execution: Dip and extend, then pull under and catch in a front rack.

Cues: Sweep the bar; Fast elbows; Soft catch

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Hang start only. Floor cleans stay on Power Clean (249). Keep Kettlebell Clean (174) separate.

rows.name: Hanging Knee Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang or support body with shoulders stable.

Execution: Raise knees toward torso without excessive swinging, then lower slowly.

Cues: No swing; Curl pelvis; Control descent

rows.name: Hanging Leg Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang with body controlled and legs straight or softly bent.

Execution: Raise legs toward horizontal or higher while controlling pelvis, then lower.

Cues: No swing; Brace; Use achievable range

rows.name: Heel Tap
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie with knees bent and shoulders slightly lifted.

Execution: Reach side to side toward heels with small trunk bends.

Cues: Ribs down; Small range; Keep tension

rows.name: Heel Walk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lift toes and forefeet while keeping heels on ground.

Execution: Walk forward on heels with controlled short steps.

Cues: Toes up; Stay tall; Short steps

rows.name: High Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set handles around upper-chest/head height and brace.

Execution: Pull elbows down and back toward ribs.

Cues: Shoulders down; Drive elbows; Avoid leaning

rows.name: Hip Abduction
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set body stable with resistance outside legs.

Execution: Move leg(s) outward without twisting pelvis, then return slowly.

Cues: Pelvis still; Control return; Don't bounce

rows.name: Hip Adduction
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set body stable with resistance positioned to draw leg inward.

Execution: Bring leg(s) toward midline and return under control.

Cues: Stay tall; Control range; No momentum

rows.name: Hip Airplane
rows.instructions:
Setup: Balance on one leg in a hinged position with hips square.

Execution: Rotate pelvis open and closed around stance hip while maintaining balance.

Cues: Move slowly; Control pelvis; Use support

rows.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Use half-kneeling stance with pelvis gently tucked.

Execution: Shift forward slightly until stretch is felt at front of rear hip.

Cues: Tuck pelvis; Squeeze rear glute; Don't overarch

rows.name: Hip Thrust
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support upper back on bench or machine and place load across hips.

Execution: Drive hips upward to full extension without overextending low back.

Cues: Chin tucked; Ribs down; Squeeze glutes

rows.name: Hollow Hold
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back and flatten lower back by bracing.

Execution: Lift shoulders and legs to a manageable position and hold.

Cues: Low back down; Breathe; Scale lever length

rows.name: Hollow Rock
rows.instructions:
Setup: Establish strong hollow-body position.

Execution: Rock gently back and forth without losing body shape.

Cues: Stay rigid; Low back controlled; Small rocks

rows.name: Incline Chest Fly
rows.instructions:
Setup: Use an incline bench with a slight elbow bend.

Execution: Arc arms together above upper chest and lower slowly.

Cues: Soft elbows; Controlled stretch; No shrugging

rows.name: Incline Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit on incline bench with arms hanging slightly behind torso.

Execution: Curl without moving upper arms forward, then lower fully.

Cues: Shoulders back; Full stretch; No swing

rows.name: Incline Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set bench to a low-to-moderate incline and brace with feet planted.

Execution: Lower toward upper chest and press upward without shrugging.

Cues: Low incline; Elbows controlled; Keep ribs down

rows.name: Incline Push-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place hands on a stable elevated surface and form a straight line head-to-heel.

Execution: Lower chest to the surface and press away.

Cues: Brace core; Control depth; Don't flare elbows

rows.name: Internal Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Keep elbow near side and bent about 90 degrees.

Execution: Rotate forearm inward while upper arm stays still.

Cues: Light load; Elbow fixed; No torso turn

rows.name: Inverted Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Pull chest toward handles/bar and lower without losing plank position.

Execution: Body straight; Squeeze shoulder blades; Control descent

Cues: Body Row; Australian Pull-Up

compatible_equipment: Set body under a fixed bar or straps in a straight line.

rows.name: Jefferson Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand on stable surface with very light load if used.

Execution: Slowly roll down segment by segment within comfortable range and reverse.

Cues: Very light; Slow; Not for loaded strength work

rows.name: Jump Rope
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold handles at sides with rope behind feet.

Execution: Turn rope mostly from wrists and make small rhythmic jumps.

Cues: Small jumps; Soft landings; Wrists turn rope

rows.name: Kettlebell Clean
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start bell from floor or swing position with strong hinge.

Execution: Use hip drive to guide bell into rack without crashing onto forearm.

Cues: Hip power; Keep bell close; Soft catch

rows.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand over bell with brace and hips hinged.

Execution: Drive through floor to stand and return bell with control.

Cues: Brace; Bell close; Smooth reps

rows.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold kettlebell by horns at chest.

Execution: Squat between hips and knees and stand tall.

Cues: Bell close; Whole foot; Knees track toes

rows.name: Kettlebell Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold bell securely in rack with wrist neutral.

Execution: Press overhead to stacked position and lower to rack.

Cues: Forearm vertical; Ribs down; Finish stacked

rows.name: Kettlebell Snatch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Begin with swing-like hinge and secure grip.

Execution: Drive bell upward with hips and guide hand around bell into overhead lockout.

Cues: Hip power; Punch through; Soft catch

rows.name: Kettlebell Swing
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with kettlebell ahead, hinge, and hike it between legs.

Execution: Snap hips forward to propel bell to about chest height, letting it return into hinge.

Cues: Hip snap; Arms relaxed; Don't squat the swing

rows.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
rows.instructions:
Setup: Face wall with foot flat a short distance away.

Execution: Drive knee toward wall over toes without heel lifting, then return.

Cues: Heel down; Knee tracks toes; Controlled reps

rows.name: Landmine Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold end of landmine near shoulder in stable stance.

Execution: Press up and forward along bar path, then return.

Cues: Ribs down; Reach; Don't shrug

rows.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold landmine end and stand with soft knees.

Execution: Push hips back while bar tracks close, then extend hips.

Cues: Hips back; Neutral spine; Hamstring stretch

rows.name: Landmine Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold landmine end with both hands and feet stable.

Execution: Arc bar from side to side with controlled trunk/hip rotation.

Cues: Brace; Control arc; Don't yank

rows.name: Landmine Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Straddle or stand beside the bar, hinge at hips, and brace.

Execution: Pull the loaded end toward torso and lower under control.

Cues: Neutral spine; Drive elbows; Don't yank

rows.name: Landmine Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold end of landmine at chest and stand facing anchor.

Execution: Squat down and drive back up while keeping load close.

Cues: Whole foot; Stay tall; Knees track toes

rows.name: Lat Pulldown
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit securely with thighs anchored and grip overhead.

Execution: Pull elbows down toward ribs, bringing handle toward upper chest, then return.

Cues: Chest tall; Elbows down; Don't swing

rows.name: Lat Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold stable support with arms extended.

Execution: Sit hips back and lower chest until stretch is felt along lats.

Cues: Ribs controlled; Breathe; Gentle

rows.name: Lateral Bound
rows.instructions:
Setup: Balance on one leg in an athletic position.

Execution: Jump laterally to opposite leg and absorb landing before repeating.

Cues: Stick landing; Knee tracks toes; Control side-to-side

rows.name: Lateral Lunge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand wide enough to step laterally with toes forward or slightly out.

Execution: Shift hips toward one side while other leg stays longer, then push back to center.

Cues: Hips back; Foot planted; Knee tracks toes

rows.name: Lateral Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand or sit tall with arms by sides and elbows soft.

Execution: Raise arms out to sides to about shoulder height and lower slowly.

Cues: Lead with elbows; No swinging; Stop near shoulder height

rows.name: Lateral Step-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand beside a stable box with one foot on top.

Execution: Drive through elevated leg to stand sideways onto box, then lower slowly.

Cues: Whole foot; Pelvis level; Control down

rows.name: Leg Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Align machine and secure pad near lower legs.

Execution: Flex knees to curl pad, squeeze hamstrings, and return slowly.

Cues: Hips stay down; Full control; Don't bounce

rows.name: Leg Extension
rows.instructions:
Setup: Align machine pivot with knee and secure pad above ankles.

Execution: Extend knees to straighten legs and lower under control.

Cues: Don't swing; Squeeze quads; Control bottom

rows.name: Leg Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set back firmly against pad and feet securely on platform.

Execution: Lower platform until comfortable hip/knee depth and press away.

Cues: Back stays down; Knees track toes; Don't lock knees

rows.name: Low Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set handle low and sit or stand with torso stable.

Execution: Pull toward lower ribs/waist and return under control.

Cues: Elbows close; Chest tall; Full reach

rows.name: Lunge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with room to step.

Execution: Step and lower both knees under control, then push back or continue forward depending on style.

Cues: Knee tracks toes; Stable step; Torso controlled

rows.name: Machine Chest Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Adjust seat so handles align around mid-chest.

Execution: Press handles forward and return under control.

Cues: Shoulders set; Wrists stacked; Control return

rows.name: Machine Pulldown
rows.instructions:
Setup: Secure thighs and grip handles overhead.

Execution: Drive elbows down to pull handles toward upper torso.

Cues: Don't swing; Full stretch; Chest tall

rows.name: Machine Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Adjust seat/chest pad and grip handles securely.

Execution: Pull handles toward torso and return to full reach.

Cues: Chest supported; Elbows back; Control

rows.name: Machine Shoulder Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Adjust seat so handles begin around shoulder height.

Execution: Press overhead and lower under control.

Cues: Ribs down; Wrists stacked; No shrugging

rows.name: Meadows Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand perpendicular to landmine and hinge with staggered stance.

Execution: Row bar end toward hip/ribs and lower to stretch.

Cues: Brace; Pull to hip; Control torso

rows.name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold ball at chest with athletic stance.

Execution: Explosively throw forward using chest and arms, catching or retrieving safely.

Cues: Explosive intent; Brace; Follow through

rows.name: Medicine Ball Rotational Throw
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand sideways to a sturdy wall with ball loaded near back hip.

Execution: Rotate explosively and throw ball into wall, then reset.

Cues: Use hips; Brace; Keep throw athletic

rows.name: Medicine Ball Slam
rows.instructions:
Setup: Raise slam ball overhead with stable stance.

Execution: Drive ball forcefully toward floor using trunk and arms.

Cues: Use slam-safe ball; Brace; Finish through floor

rows.name: Mountain Climber
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start in a strong high plank.

Execution: Drive one knee toward chest at a time while maintaining trunk position.

Cues: Hips level; Hands under shoulders; Stay controlled

rows.name: Neck Isometric
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit or stand tall and place hand against head in chosen direction.

Execution: Apply gentle pressure while resisting movement for time.

Cues: Low effort; Neutral posture; No pain

rows.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Kneel with ankles securely anchored and hips extended.

Execution: Lower torso forward as slowly as possible using hamstrings, then assist or pull back up.

Cues: Hips extended; Slow lowering; Use assistance

rows.name: One-Arm Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support torso as needed and square hips and shoulders.

Execution: Pull elbow toward hip and lower to a controlled stretch.

Cues: Pull to hip; Keep torso quiet; Full reach

rows.name: Overhead Carry
rows.instructions:
Setup: Press load overhead and establish stable shoulder position.

Execution: Walk while keeping arm stacked and torso controlled.

Cues: Arm stacked; Ribs down; Short steps

rows.name: Overhead Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Brace torso with hands around shoulder level.

Execution: Press overhead until arms are extended without excessive back arch.

Cues: Ribs down; Finish overhead; Wrists stacked

rows.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
rows.instructions:
Setup: Position resistance overhead with elbows pointing generally forward.

Execution: Bend elbows to lower behind head, then extend without flaring excessively.

Cues: Upper arms steady; Full extension; Ribs down

rows.name: Pallof Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand sideways to resistance and hold handle at chest.

Execution: Press arms forward without allowing torso to rotate, then return.

Cues: Stay square; Brace; Don't lean

rows.name: Pause Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set up for normal squat with manageable load.

Execution: Descend, pause under control at chosen depth, then drive up.

Cues: Stay braced in pause; No bounce; Whole foot

rows.name: Pec Deck
rows.instructions:
Setup: Adjust seat and pads so shoulders are comfortable.

Execution: Bring arms together and return to controlled stretch.

Cues: Chest tall; Soft elbows; No bouncing

rows.name: Pendlay Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hinge until torso is near parallel and bar starts on floor.

Execution: Row bar explosively to lower chest/upper abdomen and return to floor each rep.

Cues: Reset each rep; Brace; No torso rise

rows.name: Pendulum Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set feet and shoulders securely in machine.

Execution: Descend under control and drive through platform to stand.

Cues: Whole foot; Knees track toes; Control depth

rows.name: Pike Push-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start with hips high in an inverted-V position.

Execution: Bend elbows to lower head toward floor, then press away.

Cues: Hips high; Head travels forward/down; Control

rows.name: Plank
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set forearms or hands under shoulders and form a straight body line.

Execution: Hold while bracing abs and glutes and breathing normally.

Cues: Ribs down; Squeeze glutes; Don't sag

rows.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start in high plank with feet wide enough for control.

Execution: Tap opposite shoulder with one hand while resisting hip rotation.

Cues: Hips square; Slow taps; Push floor away

rows.name: Plate Front Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold a plate at the hips or in a goblet position, standing tall.

Execution: Raise the plate to shoulder height and lower under control.

Cues: Soft elbows; Do not swing; Ribs down

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Household mixed-name lift. Separate from Front Raise so the plate version stays its own card.

rows.name: Pogo Jump
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with knees softly bent.

Execution: Perform quick small vertical jumps primarily through ankles.

Cues: Stiff springy ankles; Quiet contacts; Stay tall

rows.name: Power Clean
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand over the bar or bells with a hip-width stance and a flat back.

Execution: Extend hips and knees explosively and catch the load on the shoulders.

Cues: Jump the weight; Fast elbows; Soft catch

coaching_metadata.design_notes: One clean card. Keep Kettlebell Clean (174) for the KB rack path.

rows.name: Power Snatch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand over the bar with a wide grip and a flat back.

Execution: Extend explosively and catch the bar overhead without sitting into a full squat.

Cues: Jump the bar; Punch up; Catch high

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Power receive. Full squat snatch is Snatch (255). Keep Kettlebell Snatch (176) separate.

rows.name: Preacher Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place upper arms securely on preacher pad.

Execution: Curl resistance up without lifting arms from pad, then lower under control.

Cues: Arms stay planted; Don't slam bottom; Smooth reps

rows.name: Pull-Through
rows.instructions:
Setup: Face away from low pulley with rope between legs.

Execution: Hinge back, then extend hips to stand while arms remain passive.

Cues: Hips back; Arms are hooks; Squeeze glutes

rows.name: Pull-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang from bar with body controlled and shoulders active.

Execution: Pull chest toward bar by driving elbows down, then lower fully.

Cues: No swinging; Full hang; Drive elbows down

rows.name: Pull-Up Work
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang from a bar with the grip you are working that day.

Execution: Pull the chest toward the bar, or accumulate assisted / partial reps as written.

Cues: Ribs down; Full hang if able; Own the last inch

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Household logged this as its own card, separate from Pull-Up and Chin-Up.

rows.name: Pullover
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie supported with weight above chest and elbows slightly bent.

Execution: Lower weight behind head within shoulder comfort and pull back over torso.

Cues: Ribs down; Soft elbows; Control stretch

rows.name: Push Jerk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Bar in a front rack, feet under the hips, elbows up.

Execution: Dip and drive, then punch the bar overhead while the feet stay roughly in place or hop slightly out.

Cues: Dip straight; Punch under; Lock the elbows

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Feet do not split. Split Jerk is its own card.

rows.name: Push Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold resistance at shoulders with feet stable.

Execution: Use a shallow knee dip and strong leg drive to accelerate weight overhead.

Cues: Dip straight; Drive hard; Finish stacked

rows.name: Push-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start in a straight plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders.

Execution: Lower chest toward floor and press back up as one unit.

Cues: Body straight; Elbows 30-60 degrees; Full range

rows.name: Quad Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand or lie and bring heel toward glute.

Execution: Hold ankle and gently increase knee flexion while pelvis stays neutral.

Cues: Knees close; Don't arch; Gentle

rows.name: Rack Pull
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set bar on safeties below or around knee height and brace.

Execution: Extend hips and knees to stand, then return to supports under control.

Cues: Brace; Bar close; No hyperextension

rows.name: Rear Delt Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hinge or use chest support with elbows flared.

Execution: Row elbows outward toward shoulder level and lower slowly.

Cues: Elbows wide; Don't shrug; Light and controlled

rows.name: Renegade Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start in high plank gripping stable weights.

Execution: Row one weight toward ribs while resisting torso rotation, then alternate.

Cues: Feet wide; Hips square; Controlled row

rows.name: Reverse Crunch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with hips and knees bent.

Execution: Curl pelvis toward ribs, lifting hips slightly, then lower slowly.

Cues: Roll pelvis; Don't swing legs; Control down

rows.name: Reverse Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold resistance with palms down and upper arms by sides.

Execution: Curl up while maintaining pronated grip and lower slowly.

Cues: Wrists neutral; Elbows fixed; Light load

rows.name: Reverse Fly
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hinge or use support with arms slightly bent.

Execution: Open arms out to sides and squeeze rear shoulders, then return.

Cues: Soft elbows; No momentum; Shoulder blades controlled

rows.name: Reverse Hyperextension
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support torso on reverse-hyper surface with legs hanging.

Execution: Extend hips to lift legs until aligned with torso, then lower slowly.

Cues: No swinging; Squeeze glutes; Controlled range

rows.name: Reverse Lunge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with feet under hips.

Execution: Step one foot backward, lower under control, and drive through front foot to return.

Cues: Front foot planted; Soft back knee; Stay balanced

rows.name: Reverse Pec Deck
rows.instructions:
Setup: Face machine and set handles near shoulder level.

Execution: Open arms outward and back, then return slowly.

Cues: No shrugging; Lead elbows; Control

rows.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support forearms with palms down and wrists free.

Execution: Extend wrists upward and lower slowly.

Cues: Light load; Forearms still; No jerking

rows.name: Romanian Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with load close to thighs and knees softly bent.

Execution: Push hips backward while load stays close, then drive hips forward to stand.

Cues: Hips back; Neutral spine; Feel hamstring stretch

rows.name: Rope Climb
rows.instructions:
Setup: Grip rope securely and use foot lock if trained.

Execution: Climb using coordinated arms and legs, then descend under control.

Cues: Learn foot lock; Control descent; Clear landing

rows.name: Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Brace torso and begin with shoulders set and arms extended.

Execution: Pull resistance toward torso, driving elbows back, then return under control.

Cues: Lead with elbows; Don't shrug; Control reach

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Use specific records below when torso position materially changes the movement.

rows.name: Row Ergometer
rows.instructions:
Setup: Strap feet and begin at catch with shins near vertical and torso braced.

Execution: Drive legs, swing torso slightly, then pull handle; reverse sequence on return.

Cues: Legs-body-arms; Smooth recovery; Don't yank

rows.name: Russian Twist
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit with torso leaned back and spine long.

Execution: Rotate torso side to side under control.

Cues: Rotate torso not just hands; Stay tall; Light load

rows.name: Scaption Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with thumbs up and arms slightly forward of your sides.

Execution: Raise arms in the scapular plane to comfortable height.

Cues: Thumbs up; Light load; No shrugging

rows.name: Scapular Pull-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hang from bar with elbows straight.

Execution: Pull shoulder blades down to slightly lift body without bending elbows, then relax under control.

Cues: Straight elbows; Small motion; No swing

rows.name: Scapular Push-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start in plank with elbows straight.

Execution: Let shoulder blades come together slightly, then push floor away to spread them.

Cues: Elbows straight; Small motion; Keep plank

rows.name: Seal Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie prone on elevated flat bench with arms hanging.

Execution: Row resistance toward torso without torso movement.

Cues: Chest stays down; Full reach; No momentum

rows.name: Seated Calf Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit with knees bent and resistance across thighs.

Execution: Raise heels as high as possible and lower slowly.

Cues: Pause top; Full stretch; Controlled reps

rows.name: Shoulder Dislocate
rows.instructions:
Setup: Take wide grip on PVC or band in front of body.

Execution: Move arms overhead and behind only through comfortable range, then return.

Cues: Wide grip; Straight arms; Never force

rows.name: Shrug
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall holding resistance at sides or front.

Execution: Elevate shoulders straight up, pause, and lower fully.

Cues: Up not circles; Pause; Keep neck neutral

rows.name: Side Bend
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall or brace on a 45° back-extension pad with the downside hip supported.

Execution: Lower sideways through the waist, then lift back to a tall torso.

Cues: Move at the waist; Do not twist; Controlled range

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Lateral flexion. Do not merge with Back Extension (80).

rows.name: Side Plank
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support body on one forearm/hand and side of feet or knees.

Execution: Lift hips and hold a straight line.

Cues: Hips high; Body straight; Shoulder stacked

rows.name: Single-Arm Chest Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set torso securely and hold one resistance at chest level.

Execution: Press with one arm while resisting torso rotation.

Cues: Stay square; Brace; Control return

rows.name: Single-Arm Overhead Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand or sit tall with one load at shoulder.

Execution: Press overhead without leaning sideways, then lower.

Cues: Stay tall; Ribs down; Arm stacked

rows.name: Single-Leg Balance
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand on one leg with soft knee and stable posture.

Execution: Maintain balance for time; progress with reach or unstable surface if appropriate.

Cues: Tripod foot; Knee soft; Stay tall

rows.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Balance on one foot with support available.

Execution: Rise onto toes and lower through full comfortable range.

Cues: Stay tall; Full range; Slow lowering

rows.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with one foot planted and other leg raised.

Execution: Drive hips upward through planted foot and lower slowly.

Cues: Pelvis level; Ribs down; Squeeze

rows.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support upper back if desired, plant one foot, and lift other leg.

Execution: Drive stance hip upward and lower without pelvis twisting.

Cues: Pelvis level; Squeeze glute; Ribs down

rows.name: Single-Leg Leg Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set machine and use one leg at a time.

Execution: Curl heel toward glute and return slowly.

Cues: Hips stable; Full control; Squeeze

rows.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set machine alignment and use one leg at a time.

Execution: Extend knee and lower under control.

Cues: Squeeze quad; No swing; Full control

rows.name: Single-Leg Leg Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place one foot securely on platform with back supported.

Execution: Lower through comfortable range and press away using one leg.

Cues: Pelvis stays down; Knee tracks toes; Control

rows.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Balance on one leg with a soft knee and square hips.

Execution: Hinge while free leg extends behind, then drive stance hip forward.

Cues: Hips square; Long spine; Move slowly

rows.name: Sissy Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Use support as needed and keep body aligned from knees upward.

Execution: Allow knees to travel forward as torso leans back, then extend knees to rise.

Cues: Use support; Controlled range; Keep tension on quads

rows.name: Sit-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie with knees bent and feet stable as appropriate.

Execution: Curl and rise torso toward thighs, then lower under control.

Cues: Exhale; Don't pull neck; Controlled

rows.name: Skull Crusher
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on bench with arms extended above shoulders.

Execution: Bend elbows to lower resistance near forehead or behind head, then extend.

Cues: Upper arms steady; Control bottom; Wrists neutral

rows.name: Sled Pull
rows.instructions:
Setup: Attach or grip sled safely with clear path.

Execution: Walk or pull sled using controlled continuous steps.

Cues: Stay braced; Clear path; Smooth tension

rows.name: Sled Push
rows.instructions:
Setup: Grip sled handles, lean forward, and brace.

Execution: Drive through legs with short powerful steps to move sled.

Cues: Keep pushing; Strong posture; Full foot drive

rows.name: Sliding Leg Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie on back with heels on sliders and hips elevated.

Execution: Slide heels away and back while keeping hips controlled.

Cues: Hips up; Slow extension; Don't arch

rows.name: Smith Calf Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Position bar securely and balls of feet on stable surface if used.

Execution: Rise onto toes and lower through controlled stretch.

Cues: Use safeties; Full range; Pause top

rows.name: Smith Split Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set staggered stance under bar and use safeties.

Execution: Lower rear knee and drive through front foot to rise.

Cues: Stable stance; Front foot planted; Controlled

rows.name: Smith Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set bar and feet so path is comfortable and stable.

Execution: Descend under control and stand by driving through feet.

Cues: Use safeties; Whole foot; Knees track toes

rows.name: Snatch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand over the bar with a wide grip, hips high, and a flat back.

Execution: Extend the hips and knees explosively and receive the bar overhead in a squat, then stand.

Cues: Bar close; Fast turnover; Lock out overhead

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Full snatch from the floor. Hang Snatch is an alias. Keep Kettlebell Snatch (176) separate. Power Snatch is its own card.

rows.name: Spanish Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Anchor thick band/strap behind knees and lean back into tension.

Execution: Sit down with torso upright and stand by extending knees.

Cues: Stay upright; Keep tension; Controlled

rows.name: Spider Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with arms hanging.

Execution: Curl while upper arms remain vertical and lower fully.

Cues: No shoulder swing; Squeeze top; Slow lowering

rows.name: Split Jerk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Bar in a front rack, feet under the hips, elbows up.

Execution: Dip and drive, then split the feet and lock the bar overhead before recovering the stance.

Cues: Dip straight; Split under; Recover the feet

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Competition jerk footwork. Push Jerk stays its own card.

rows.name: Split Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Take a staggered stance with feet remaining in place.

Execution: Lower back knee toward floor and drive through front foot to rise.

Cues: Stable stance; Front knee tracks toes; Stay tall

rows.name: Squat Jump
rows.instructions:
Setup: Start athletic and dip into a shallow squat.

Execution: Explode upward, land softly, and reset as needed.

Cues: Land quiet; Knees track toes; Quality over fatigue

rows.name: Stair Climber
rows.instructions:
Setup: Step onto machine securely and select manageable pace.

Execution: Climb continuously while maintaining upright posture.

Cues: Don't hang on rails; Full foot when possible; Steady pace

rows.name: Standing Calf Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with balls of feet supported and heels free if possible.

Execution: Rise onto toes, pause, and lower through a controlled stretch.

Cues: Full stretch; Pause top; Don't bounce

rows.name: Step-Down
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand on a low step with one foot near edge.

Execution: Slowly bend stance leg to tap opposite heel toward floor, then stand.

Cues: Knee tracks toes; Slow eccentric; Pelvis level

rows.name: Step-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Place whole foot on a stable box or bench.

Execution: Drive through the elevated leg to stand on box, then descend under control.

Cues: Use lead leg; Whole foot on box; Control down

rows.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with knees only slightly bent and load close.

Execution: Hinge at hips through a controlled hamstring stretch and return to standing.

Cues: Soft knees; Hinge not squat; Control depth

rows.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand facing a high pulley with arms nearly straight.

Execution: Sweep arms down toward thighs without turning it into a triceps press.

Cues: Soft elbows; Ribs down; Pull from lats

rows.name: Suitcase Carry
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall holding a load on one side.

Execution: Walk while resisting leaning toward or away from the load.

Cues: Stay tall; Short controlled steps; Don't lean

rows.name: Sumo Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Take wide stance with toes out and grip inside legs.

Execution: Push floor apart and stand while keeping bar close.

Cues: Knees track toes; Chest controlled; Bar close

rows.name: Sumo Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Take wider stance with toes turned out comfortably.

Execution: Squat down while knees track toes, then stand.

Cues: Whole foot; Knees out; Stay tall

rows.name: Svend Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hold a plate or dumbbells pressed together at chest height.

Execution: Press forward while squeezing inward, then return.

Cues: Constant inward pressure; Ribs down; Slow reps

rows.name: T Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie prone or hinge with arms out to sides.

Execution: Raise arms into a T while squeezing upper back, then lower.

Cues: Light load; No shrugging; Pause

rows.name: T-Bar Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set chest or torso position securely and grip handles.

Execution: Row handles toward torso and return to full reach.

Cues: Chest tall; Elbows back; Controlled stretch

rows.name: Tempo Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set up for squat and choose a controlled tempo.

Execution: Descend according to prescribed count, then rise under control.

Cues: Own every position; Stay braced; Don't rush

rows.name: Thoracic Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set up side-lying or quadruped with lower body stable.

Execution: Rotate upper torso through comfortable range while pelvis stays controlled.

Cues: Rotate upper back; Breathe; Don't force

rows.name: Tibialis Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with heels planted and room for toes to lift.

Execution: Pull toes toward shins and lower slowly.

Cues: Heels down; Full lift; Controlled reps

rows.name: Toe Walk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Rise onto toes with tall posture.

Execution: Walk forward while keeping heels elevated.

Cues: Stay tall; Small steps; Maintain heel height

rows.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand centered inside trap bar and brace before lifting.

Execution: Drive through floor to stand tall, then hinge and bend knees to return.

Cues: Stay centered; Brace; Smooth lockout

rows.name: Treadmill Run
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set safe speed and begin gradually.

Execution: Run with relaxed upper body and controlled foot strike.

Cues: Build speed gradually; Stay centered; Relax shoulders

rows.name: Treadmill Walk
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set safe speed/incline and stand centered on belt.

Execution: Walk naturally without holding rails unless needed for safety.

Cues: Tall posture; Natural stride; Use safe incline

rows.name: Triceps Kickback
rows.instructions:
Setup: Hinge and position upper arm alongside torso with elbow bent.

Execution: Extend forearm backward until straight, then return without moving upper arm.

Cues: Upper arm fixed; Light load; Full squeeze

rows.name: Triceps Pushdown
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall at a high pulley with elbows near sides.

Execution: Extend elbows until arms straighten, then return without upper-arm movement.

Cues: Elbows pinned; No torso swing; Full extension

rows.name: Trunk Rotation
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, arms extended.

Execution: Rotate the trunk against the line of pull, then return with control.

Cues: Turn from the ribs; Soft knees; Do not yank the arms

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Cable is the default implement. Do not map to Cable Chop unless it was a high-to-low chop.

rows.name: Turkish Get-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie with load locked over one shoulder and same-side knee bent.

Execution: Move through supported positions to standing while keeping load stacked, then reverse.

Cues: Eyes on load early; Move slowly; Shoulder stacked

rows.name: Turkish Sit-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie with one arm holding load vertically and same knee bent.

Execution: Roll onto elbow then hand while keeping load stacked, then reverse.

Cues: Eyes on load; Arm stacked; Move slowly

rows.name: Upright Row
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with resistance in front of thighs.

Execution: Pull elbows upward within a comfortable shoulder range.

Cues: Lead elbows; Stop if pinching; Don't yank

rows.name: V-Squat
rows.instructions:
Setup: Set shoulders and feet securely in machine.

Execution: Squat through comfortable range and drive upward.

Cues: Brace; Knees track toes; Don't bounce

rows.name: V-Up
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie long on back with arms overhead.

Execution: Raise torso and legs toward each other, then lower with control.

Cues: Exhale up; Control down; Don't yank neck

rows.name: Walking Knee Hug
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with space to walk.

Execution: Pull one knee toward chest briefly, step forward, and alternate.

Cues: Stay tall; Don't yank; Balance

rows.name: Walking Lunge
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with clear space ahead.

Execution: Step into each lunge and transition forward into the next repetition.

Cues: Controlled steps; Knee tracks toes; Don't rush

rows.name: Walking Quad Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand tall with space to walk.

Execution: Bring heel toward glute, briefly hold ankle, step forward, and alternate.

Cues: Knees close; Pelvis neutral; Stay tall

rows.name: Wall Sit
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lean back against wall and slide to desired knee angle.

Execution: Hold position while maintaining full foot contact.

Cues: Breathe; Knees track toes; Back supported

rows.name: Wall Slide
rows.instructions:
Setup: Stand with back/forearms near wall in a comfortable position.

Execution: Slide arms upward while maintaining rib and shoulder control.

Cues: Ribs down; No shrugging; Pain-free range

rows.name: Windmill
rows.instructions:
Setup: Press one bell overhead and turn the feet about 45 degrees toward the free hand.

Execution: Hinge and rotate to the free-hand side, then stand back up with the overhead arm locked.

Cues: Eyes on the bell; Long overhead arm; Hinge do not just side-bend

coaching_metadata.design_notes: Advanced is a difficulty label, not a separate exercise.

rows.name: World's Greatest Stretch
rows.instructions:
Setup: Step into long lunge with hands near front foot.

Execution: Move through hip stretch and thoracic rotation with controlled breathing.

Cues: Long spine; Breathe; Don't force

rows.name: Wrist Curl
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support forearms with palms up and wrists free.

Execution: Curl wrists upward and lower through comfortable range.

Cues: Forearms still; Small range; Control

rows.name: Wrist Pronation/Supination
rows.instructions:
Setup: Support forearm with elbow bent and hold light lever.

Execution: Rotate palm up and down through controlled range.

Cues: Very light; Forearm supported; Slow

rows.name: Y Raise
rows.instructions:
Setup: Lie prone or hinge with thumbs up and arms angled in a Y.

Execution: Raise arms in Y pattern without shrugging, then lower slowly.

Cues: Light load; Thumbs up; Reach long

rows.name: Z Press
rows.instructions:
Setup: Sit on floor with legs extended and torso upright.

Execution: Press overhead while maintaining tall unsupported posture.

Cues: Stay tall; Ribs down; Use manageable load
